public.description_short: Compact 6 ft tabletop head/banner display graphic, 72.83 x 17.72 in, printed double-sided with the same art on both sides.
public.description_long: The 6FT Table Top Banner - S is a compact 6-foot tabletop head/banner display graphic with a finished size of 72.83 x 17.72 in. It is printed double-sided using the same artwork on both sides, and the finished shape carries a 3.94 in corner radius. Artwork should be supplied at a minimum of 50 dpi at final size. Keep critical content clear of the finished edge; the exact safe zone is confirmed against the production template for this SKU. Substrate and display hardware are confirmed per order and are not specified by this registry entry.

internal.notes: Factory template filename as documented: Table-top-banner-S-6FT-other-fabircs-4-2.ai (filename spelling preserved as received from vendor). safe_zone_in of 1.0 comes from the House Template v2 reference build default and must be verified against the factory die before it is trusted for automated preflight. template_drive_id is unresolved. default_substrate is null because no substrate has been explicitly confirmed for this SKU. pricing_guide_url is null because the pricing guide row has not been confirmed; pricing never comes from this registry and the PO remains the source of truth. vendor_sku is set to TBD-6-S because the seed key and the vendor/product key are treated as the same value in existing records. ordant_product_id is not yet assigned.
